# thousandeyes_credential (Ephemeral Resource)

Opens a ThousandEyes credential's decrypted value for the duration of a plan or apply, without the value ever being persisted to state. The natural consumer is another provider's configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
ephemeral "thousandeyes_credential" "example" {
  id = "<id>"
}

# An ephemeral value lives for the run and never reaches state. Reference it from
# another provider's configuration, e.g.:
#
#   ephemeral.thousandeyes_credential.example.value
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique ID of the credential to open.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) The name of the credential.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The decrypted value of the credential. Ephemeral by construction: it lives for the run and never reaches state.
